label: Scope: required behaviour, supporting data and left-out capabilities agree in every step
Home: a product-discovery page, no marketing funnel
Tests: what a person sees, not internal names or placeholder phrases
Save journey: complete, with its starting sign-in state
Data owners: one for records, one for saved state
Look: stated as selected, proposed or none; no implied design approval
Required records: the PRD's explicit records, as given
Navigation: the PRD's declared destinations only
Excluded capabilities: nothing the PRD rules out
Runtime state: the PRD's state, one shared owner
Acceptance tests agree with the PRD's records
problems: "enter 'Outdoor' in search field → photos matching Outdoor category are displayed": "Outdoor" is a photo category, not a title the search matches
"select 'Nature' from category dropdown → only Nature category photos appear in grid": "Nature" isn't one of the category options (outdoor, studio)

label: Look: the PRD's visual direction, no invented exact values
